# terrakube_collection_item (Data Source)

Looks up a collection item by key within a Terrakube collection. The same key can exist in more than one category, so set `category` when it does. `value` is null for sensitive items, and the attribute is always marked sensitive.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "terrakube_organization" "org" {
  name = "my-organization"
}

data "terrakube_collection" "shared" {
  organization_id = data.terrakube_organization.org.id
  name            = "shared-settings"
}

# category is only needed when the key exists as both ENV and TERRAFORM.
data "terrakube_collection_item" "region" {
  organization_id = data.terrakube_organization.org.id
  collection_id   = data.terrakube_collection.shared.id
  key             = "AWS_REGION"
  category        = "ENV"
}

output "aws_region" {
  value     = data.terrakube_collection_item.region.value
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `collection_id` (String) Terrakube collection ID
- `key` (String) Item key
- `organization_id` (String) Terrakube organization ID

### Optional

- `category` (String) Item category, ENV or TERRAFORM. Required when the key exists in both.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Item description
- `hcl` (Boolean) Whether the value is HCL
- `id` (String) Collection item ID
- `sensitive` (Boolean) Whether the item is sensitive
- `value` (String, Sensitive) Item value. Null when the item is sensitive.
